card.title: Keeping Score
card.instruction: Treat arrival times, effort, memory, and sacrifice as a running score you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I carried the heavier shopping bag. Again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll put everything away. Carrying gets points, but remembering where things go gets double.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put it away too. You sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. I'll count how many times you ask me which cupboard. Those go in my column.
